title: Change timeline
lead: What changed in the cluster, when and by whom. Sextant records changes of the objects it watches while it is connected; earlier changes come from what the cluster keeps and are marked as partial.
tabLead: Changes Sextant recorded while it watched this object, and what the cluster keeps from before (partial).
tabEmpty: No changes of this object are known yet.
objectHistoryFailed: The cluster's history of this object could not be read: {{message}}

filters.persistHint: Recorded changes are saved on this computer, one file per cluster. Secret values are never recorded.

saveFailed: The timeline could not be saved: {{message}}
partialNeedsNamespaces: Choose namespaces in the filter to see the history from before Sextant was running.
partialFirstNamespaces_one: The history before Sextant covers the first {{count}} namespace of the filter.
partialFirstNamespaces_other: The history before Sextant covers the first {{count}} namespaces of the filter.
relatedLimited_one: Problems on dependent objects are matched in the first {{count}} namespace of the filter.
relatedLimited_other: Problems on dependent objects are matched in the first {{count}} namespaces of the filter.
allNamespacesNote: With all namespaces, a problem is matched to a change of the same object or of the workload it is named after.
partialSkipped: Some lists could not be read: {{kinds}}
partialTruncated: The history before Sextant is long: only the newest entries are shown.
empty: No changes are known yet. They appear here as objects change while Sextant watches them.
lateTitle: Nothing watched this object for a while: the change was made before this time.
partialTitle: From what the cluster keeps: not every change made before Sextant was running is known.

source.fieldManager: Last change by this field manager

who.unknown: Who made it is not known

change.summaryOnly: Changed; the earlier version was too large to keep, so the changed fields are not known.

correlation.label: Soon after this change
correlation.sameTime: {{reason}} on {{kind}} {{name}} at about the same time
